existing_work_pattern.ReasoningBank_MaTTS: 3 public benchmark families, multiple backbones, No-Memory/Synapse/AWM baselines, scaling controls, efficiency/generalization/ablations
existing_work_pattern.SkillCAT: SpreadsheetBench-Verified plus full SpreadsheetBench, WikiTQ OOD, DocVQA transfer, matched and cross-model users, No-Skill/Human/Parametric/Trace2Skill baselines, component ablations
existing_work_pattern.SkillOpt: 6 benchmarks, 7 target models, 3 harnesses, 52 cells, human/one-shot/Trace2Skill/TextGrad/GEPA/EvoSkill baselines and transfer
existing_work_pattern.RethinkSkill: 5 benchmarks, 3 primary models, 42 matched feedback runs over 14 settings, Parent/Normal/Fail-only/Success-only plus TTS, repeated evaluation, robustness and transfer
existing_work_pattern.Branch2Skill: 6 benchmarks, several target models, SkillOpt comparison, token-efficiency accounting and tree ablations
existing_work_pattern.SkillZip: 3 procedural benchmarks x 3 backbones, uncompressed/SkillReducer comparisons, compression/fidelity/cost/transfer/continual axes
existing_work_pattern.SkillZip_Pro: narrower production setting but deep systems accounting across bundle/per-run/routing and unsafe variants

recommended_public_anchor.reason: public realistic substrate shared by SkillCAT, SkillOpt and RethinkSkill, already locally pinned, enables closest-method common-harness reruns
recommended_public_anchor.primary_model_reason: already used by E2 and a primary RethinkSkill model; maximizes model-level comparability
recommended_public_anchor.split_policy: freeze outcome-blind before any public result; if no E2 public split is already content-addressed, prefer an externally released reproducible split such as SkillOpt's 80/40/280 Verified-400 train/validation/test split

main_common_harness_rows: Trace2Skill official if pinned, otherwise clearly labelled SkillCAT-style contrast
E2-R17 frozen projection policy only after prospectively earned policy authority

evaluation_policy.main_table: one unified E2 public split/harness/model/evaluator/accounting contract for direct ranking
evaluation_policy.source_faithful_appendix: released method split/protocol where official code exists; implementation validation only, no cross-split direct ranking
evaluation_policy.final_state_repeats: prefer 3 fixed-panel reevaluations of selected artifacts rather than multiplying every full evolution lineage

optional_not_mandatory: Parallel Sampling / Sequential Refinement acting-compute controls
full SkillCAT pipeline if stable first-party code is pinned
second model family robustness after positive controlled/public gates
not_recommended: more synthetic skeletons before V3 outcome
baseline spending to rescue a failed V3 mechanism
minimum_strong_package: one public SpreadsheetBench Verified natural transport
